units.source_text: 汉子像发疯似的，拼命拉着挡雨板，转眼间卸了下来，用双手举起，连人带板倒落在女佣的房间里。

en.t: The man, as if he had gone mad, desperately pulled at the rain shutter, wrenched it off in an instant, lifted it with both hands, and tumbled together with the board into the maid's room.
Inside the window it was pitch dark.

units.source_text: 阿芳倏地向桥的方向跑去。

en.t: Afang suddenly ran toward the bridge.

units.source_text: 阿泷冲着正脱游泳衣的阿雪说：

en.t: Ataki called out to Axue, who was just taking off her swimsuit:
